crystal_phase.Au–Ag: face-centered cubic (fcc) structures of the Au (Ag) bulk metals

Proof in the paper: The Au–Ag nanoparticles show almost the same interplanar spacings of 0.246 nm and 0.213 nm, with a face angle of 123°, corresponding to the (1 1 1) and (2 0 0) planes of the face-centered cubic (fcc) structures of the Au (Ag) bulk metals, respectively, which are consistent with the XRD results.
